_comment: Known defects inherited from upstream 2.2. Reported but not failing, so new violations are visible. This ledger only shrinks - remove entries as the referenced issues are fixed. Regenerate deliberately, never to silence a new failure.

item-curve.issue: #373. The 108 psionic chips were repriced in #338; what remains is the 22 other items #354 made visible - and #373 argues three of those groups want a CURVE_EXEMPT entry rather than a reprice.

merge-value.issue: #334. The 47 grenades are the one merged economy #380 did not touch, because #334 owns the whole question rather than only the price. Listed here rather than exempted in the check, so closing that issue means clearing these rows - an exemption would have made them invisible and the issue quietly unfinishable. The three cybernetic implants that sat here were cleared by #335, which is what a baseline row is supposed to end as.
